caption: Potato-chickpea-pork belly waffle as easy baby lunch for 12 months old Zen 🧇 This easy yet wholesome lunch is rich in fiber and protein, and also an excellent source of carb and fat. Here’s the recipe: 1. Mash Steamed potatoes (3/4 ~ 1 lb) 2. Add 1/2 cup of chickpea flour 3. Add 1/4 lb of pork belly (or low sodium bacon) — I used thinly sliced pork belly to avoid added sodium 4. Add 1/2 cup of milk and mix 5. Put into waffle maker and wait until fully cooked (cooking time varies depending on waffle maker types; start at low to med heat and raise to high heat at the end) . . . . #babymeals#cooking#cookwithme#blw#babyledweaning#babyledweaningideas#blwrecipes#easyrecipes#easymeals#healthyrecipes#porkbelly#brunch#easybreakfast#toddlermeals#toddlersnacks#healthyeating
